say:0:1410317101:4.text: Hammie... did we just hear something mind-blowing?
say:0:1410317101:4.source_cn: 漫漫……我们刚刚是不是听到了一些不得了的事情……

say:1:1410317102:1.text: Yes, and now I'm full of questions!
say:1:1410317102:1.source_cn: 没错，我现在有一堆问题！

say:2:1410317103:1.text: Zanie, are you really not working with Eldric and his crew? You sure seemed pretty familiar with them!
say:2:1410317103:1.source_cn: 祖娅，你和弗林他们真不是一伙的？！

say:3:1410317104:1.text: Of course not! How many times do I have to deny it?

say:4:1410317105:1.text: But you sounded so familiar with them just now! If you're not in league with them, spill everything you know! Stop hiding things!
say:4:1410317105:1.source_cn: 明明刚才话里那么熟络的样子……既然如此，那请你把自己知...

say:5:1410317106:1.text: Alright, alright! But what exactly do you want to know?
say:5:1410317106:1.source_cn: 好吧，我考虑一下！不过，你们到底想知道什么啊？

choice_prompt:6:1410317106.text: Alright, alright! But what exactly do you want to know?
choice_prompt:6:1410317106.source_cn: 好吧，我考虑一下！不过，你们到底想知道什么啊？

say:7:1410317107:1.text: It's all about faith. People in your Empire follow Dura, but we dwarves have always honored Helthor.
say:7:1410317107:1.source_cn: 还不是信仰问题。耀光境内都信艾雅……

say:8:1410317108:1.text: Even though Helthor's gone, there's still a stubborn bunch who refuse to switch their allegiance. That's the Brimstone folks for you. So they want to build a temple.
say:8:1410317108:1.source_cn: 但赫托老爹才是我们矮人最初侍奉的神明。就算老爹没了，有...

say:9:1410317109:1.text: Personally, I think it's pointless. Faith doesn't lie in brick and mortar. It's all in the heart.
say:9:1410317109:1.source_cn: 但要我说真没什么意思，信仰在心里，不依赖外物。

say:10:1410317110:0.text: Helthor is long gone, and he's not coming back.
say:10:1410317110:0.source_cn: 赫托老爹早没了，没得干干净净，也不会回来了。

say:11:1410317111:1.text: Reviving Helthor? Ridiculous! Someone found this ancient slab with some kind of mystic mumbo jumbo.
say:11:1410317111:1.source_cn: 这事更是扯得很！之前有人挖出了一块古老的石板，上面记载...

say:12:1410317112:1.text: One part was about <style="highlight">reviving a god</style>.

say:13:1410317113:0.text: It's even more absurd than the stories I made up as a kid! I'm not stupid enough to believe such nonsense.
say:13:1410317113:0.source_cn: 这简直比我小时候随口乱编的故事还离谱！我可没有蠢到相信...

say:14:1410317114:1.text: Echorites are an extremely rare underground mineral found only in Essail-controlled territory.
say:14:1410317114:1.source_cn: 深岩晶是一种极其稀有的地下矿藏，只在艾塞勒管辖的地方出产。

say:15:1410317115:1.text: They're used to make weapons that are incredibly resilient—light as a feather and able to resist certain magic.
say:15:1410317115:1.source_cn: 用它制作的武器韧性非凡，重量极轻，还能抵抗某些特殊的魔...

say:16:1410317116:0.text: Oh, we've seen one! That greatsword Eldric showed General Hogan was amazing!
say:16:1410317116:0.source_cn: 噢，那我们见过！弗林给霍根将军的那把大剑就很不寻常！

say:17:1410317117:1.text: Because, you see, we dwarves can't use magic.
say:17:1410317117:1.source_cn: 因为我们矮人不会魔法。

say:18:1410317118:1.text: Is it really that simple? I mean, even if Helthor came back, how would that let you use magic?
say:18:1410317118:1.source_cn: 就这么简单？就算赫托能复活，他就能让你们使用魔法了吗？

say:19:1410317119:1.text: Ages ago, when Helthor was around, we dwarves had magic too.
say:19:1410317119:1.source_cn: 在很久很久以前，赫托老爹还在的时候，我们矮人也曾是身怀...

say:20:1410317120:1.text: Is your lack of magic connected to Helthor's fall?
say:20:1410317120:1.source_cn: 你们不能使用魔法，跟赫托陨落有关吗？

say:21:1410317121:1.text: ... Not entirely, but many of my kin believe that if Helthor were revived, we might regain our magic.
say:21:1410317121:1.source_cn: ……不尽然，只是有些同胞天真地认为若是能复活赫托，我们...

say:22:1410317122:1.text: What's absurd is the fact that we've gone far longer without magic than we ever had it.
say:22:1410317122:1.source_cn: 可笑的是，我们没有魔法的岁月，已经远比拥有魔法的时代漫长了。

say:23:1410317123:1.text: But these are just some old tales. Because of them, we're working with the Essail, trading our skills and labor for echorites and land to build this temple...
say:23:1410317123:1.source_cn: 这就是我所知道的一切了，都是些陈年旧事。因为这些事，所...

say:24:1410317124:1.text: So, do you believe me now?
say:24:1410317124:1.source_cn: 现在你们愿意相信我了吗？

choice_prompt:25:1410317124.text: So, do you believe me now?
choice_prompt:25:1410317124.source_cn: 现在你们愿意相信我了吗？

say:26:1410317125:0.text: I'm a researcher at heart. I only trust what I see with my own eyes.
say:26:1410317125:0.source_cn: 作为一个研究者，我只相信眼前看得到的东西。

say:27:1410317128:0.text: Enough of this. Let's get moving! This royal city isn't exactly rolling out the red carpet for us, and I'd rather not run into any more of those high-and-mighty nobles.
say:27:1410317128:0.source_cn: 闲话少说，我们快点离开吧。这座漂亮的王城不太欢迎我们，...

say:28:1410317129:0.text: The lift platform is to the west. Follow me.
say:28:1410317129:0.source_cn: 记得升降平台在西边，跟我来。

say:30:1410317126:0.text: For now? Haha! Well, it's always wise to be cautious.
say:30:1410317126:0.source_cn: 暂且？哈哈，谨慎些总是好的。

choice:25:1:2.text: I'll take you at your word for now.
choice:25:1:2.male: I'll take you at your word for now.
choice:25:1:2.female: I'll take you at your word for now.

say:31:1410317127:0.text: You can tell whoever you want but don't mention my name. A good dwarf knows when to keep their mouth shut.
say:31:1410317127:0.source_cn: 你们要告诉谁都行，但别说是从我这里听来的。好矮人的嘴巴...

choice:25:2:3.text: We need to report back soon.
choice:25:2:3.source_cn: 我们得跟特使说明情况
choice:25:2:3.male: We need to report back soon.
choice:25:2:3.female: We need to report back soon.

choice:6:3:4.text: So why try to revive Helthor?
choice:6:3:4.source_cn: 所以为什么要复活赫托？
choice:6:3:4.male: So why try to revive Helthor?
choice:6:3:4.female: So why try to revive Helthor?
